newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends slightly up in dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends slightly up in dull session.

text.p: The taka edged marginally up at 42.5470/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous close at 42.5475/5495, dealers said.
Dealers said the session was dull and listless with turnover totalling less than $6 million due to weekend closure of most international markets.
Interbank call money rates ended mostly steady at 4.50 percent to 5.50 percent against the previous 4.25-5.25 percent, dealers said.
